notebookEntry.result:
Protein Builder cloning assembly design

Construct: Protein Builder Insert
Backbone: 004_CD22
Assembled construct length: 5,686 bp
Recommended route: Restriction ligation
Primer threshold: strict

PCR program
Polymerase: High-fidelity DNA polymerase
Longest PCR target: 465 bp
- Initial denaturation: 98 C, 30 s, 1 cycle
- Denaturation: 98 C, 10 s, 30 cycles
- Annealing: 55 C, 20 s, 30 cycles
- Extension: 72 C, 30 s, 30 cycles
- Final extension: 72 C, 2 min, 1 cycle
- Hold: 4 C, hold, 1 cycle
- Annealing temperature is estimated from the lowest primer binding Tm (58.2 C) minus 3 C.
- Extension is estimated at 30 s/kb for the longest planned PCR target (465 bp). Adjust to the polymerase data sheet.

Primers
- Protein Builder Insert_F; role: Restriction Forward; sequence: GCGCTGATCACACCACCACCACCACCACGAAAAC; length: 34 nt; Tm: 60.8 C; GC: 58.8%; notes: Adds BclI to the 5' end.
- Protein Builder Insert_R; role: Restriction Reverse; sequence: GCGCACGCGTATGATGGTGATGGTGGTGTGACTGAAA; length: 37 nt; Tm: 58.2 C; GC: 54.1%; notes: Adds MluI to the 5' end.

Assembly procedure
1. Amplify insert: PCR-amplify the insert with restriction-site tails from the primer plan.
2. Digest DNA: Digest backbone and insert with the selected enzyme pair, then purify both products.
3. Ligate construct: Ligate digested insert into the prepared backbone.
4. Transform and screen: Transform competent cells and screen colonies by colony PCR and sequencing.

Validation plan
- colony-pcr, left/right cloning junctions: Confirm insert presence and orientation.
- sanger-sequencing, entire insert region: Verify insert integrity after ligation.

Warnings
- Existing terminal overlap is too weak; engineered primer overlap is recommended.
- No supported edit request was provided.
